# S1 — Northstar Assist

> Fixture data. Not market evidence.

## Synthetic control text

The customer asked for a refund by Friday.

Your support lead promised a replacement instead.

By Monday, the ticket summary says only: “Customer unhappy. Follow up soon.”

Northstar Assist turns a completed support conversation into a draft resolution note with the promised action, named owner, and due date placed at the top. In a fictional 21-day control study, its synthetic records showed 87% agreement with a human-created action ledger.

It does not answer the customer or decide the remedy. It prepares the first draft so the support lead can verify the commitment before replying.
